title: MACHEREY-NAGEL Double-Size Select
author: MACHEREY-NAGEL
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Prepare OT‑2 for selection
steps.instruction: Perform the following preparation steps before starting the OT‑2 run:

substeps.instruction: Fill the 12‑Well Buffer Reservoir according to the provided table.
Resuspend the NucleoMag® NGS bead suspension by vortexing.
Load the instrument deck according to the displayed positions.
Place the square‑well block containing the lysates on the Magnetic Module and start the run.

steps.title: Remove large fragments
steps.instruction: Execute the removal of large DNA fragments as defined in the OT‑2 protocol.

steps.title: Remove small fragments
steps.instruction: Execute the removal of small DNA fragments as defined in the OT‑2 protocol.

steps.title: First wash
steps.instruction: Perform Wash 1 as programmed in the OT‑2 workflow.

steps.title: Second wash
steps.instruction: Perform Wash 2 as programmed in the OT‑2 workflow.

steps.title: Elute DNA
steps.instruction: Carry out the elution step according to the OT‑2 protocol.

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol
steps.instruction: Download the protocol package and unzip it if necessary.

steps.title: Upload custom labware
steps.instruction: In the OT App, go to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and select any required .json labware files.

steps.title: Upload protocol file
steps.instruction: In the OT App’s Protocol tab, upload the .py protocol file.

steps.title: Set up deck map
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck according to the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Calibrate all labware, tip racks, and the pipette using the OT App (refer to support articles for calibration tips).

steps.title: Run the protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT App to start the automated workflow.
